note: Both sets contain redundant near-duplicate claims (each bulb wattage and the T24 fixture requirement appear twice), but Set B binds the conditions more faithfully: it states the light-output equivalence context ('equivalent light output to 40W incandescent') and keeps the stated condition 'if luminaires are connected to a vacancy sensor'. Set A substitutes an inferred condition ('when connected to luminaires with dimmer switches') for the vacancy-sensor condition and splits each wattage into trivially duplicated 'power'/'power consumption' claims. Neither set captures the lighting-levels table in the page image, so that gap is shared.
